Settings

Account and workspace preferences for Georgia EPD

Dashboard

Workspace

Applies to everyone in the Georgia EPD workspace.

Inventory submission types

Which inventory tabs appear on the Submissions page. Baseline inventories are required of every community and NTNC system by 11/01/2027 and are the default. Both also shows the Initial Inventory tab, for states carrying LCRR submission history — workspaces onboarded after this release have none.

Monthly Operating Reports tab

Shows the statewide MOR rollup — submissions received, data completeness, turbidity exceedances, compliance trends and missed monitoring — as a tab on the State Dashboard. Separate from the Monthly Operating Reports page in the sidebar, which lists individual facility reports for a single month.

Appearance

Prototype

For comparing treatments in review. Saved in this browser only.

Sidebar color

The ground behind the navigation. Light sidebars use the color logo, dark sidebars the white one. Every option keeps its labels at AA contrast.

Dashboard style

Standard is the Calypso dashboard. The others carry the same modules on an image of clean water, each with a different hero structure. Combined pairs the Lake dashboard with a photo banner on every other page.

Opening a submission

Whether a submission opens in a wide flyout over its table, keeping the reviewer's place in the list, or as its own full page. Mixed gives baseline inventories, the longest review, their own page and opens Initial Inventory and Customer Notice submissions in a flyout.

Submission details layout

Applies to submissions that open as a page. Where a submission page shows its details (submission, water system, public access): in a column beside the page, or across the top of it.
